case_scope: Germany national wealth/housing order with renter-security substitution screen

bottom_50_private_wealth_share.note: Needs direct DWA/PHF extraction; low homeownership and wealth concentration require caution.

top_1_private_wealth_share.note: Top-tail score not the dominant live breach but remains part of share plausibility.

lower_half_real_floor.note: Social protection and tenant rules support floor, but rent pressure and low social-housing breadth can drain lower-income households.

tenant_security_substitution.note: Majority renting can be morally defensible where tenant protections and affordability hold; current shortage prevents a pass.

renter_cost_burden.note: Low-income renters and single-person/single-parent households face elevated burden and overburden risk.

nonowner_foothold_substitution.note: Secure renting may substitute for homeownership, but renter savings room and non-housing asset accumulation need direct evidence.

social_housing_access_breadth.note: Social housing stock is much narrower than Vienna-style broad public/nonprofit housing, weakening market discipline.

rental_market_shortage_pressure.note: Construction shortfalls and rising rents keep washout active.

group_person_closure.note: Migrant-background households, single parents, and low-income renters need subgroup scoring.

proof_debt: direct renter savings-room and wealth-accumulation by tenure
social housing wait and portability data

opening_package.first_lane: renter security and social/nonprofit housing breadth
opening_package.monitoring_lane: rent burden, social-housing stock, construction completion, and subgroup access

share_plausibility.why: Needs direct DWA/PHF extraction and top-tail correction.

floor_reality.why: Tenant protections help but rent pressure can drain the floor.

renter_security_substitution.why: Non-ownership can substitute only if affordability, access breadth, quality, portability, and savings room hold.

evidence_debt_register.question: Can lower-income renters accumulate liquid and pension/financial assets while renting securely?
evidence_debt_register.next_evidence: tenure-by-wealth and savings-rate extraction from PHF/OECD/administrative sources

evidence_debt_register.question: How often do deposits, guarantors, temporary furnished leases, or discrimination block first leases?
evidence_debt_register.next_evidence: lease-entry and landlord-screening data by age/migrant status/household type

validation_notes: bounded active proxy case; not a certified Germany country report.
